prompt: In 120 to 180 words, compare robustness and resilience in machine-learning systems in exactly four numbered points. Include one stress-test example and finish with a one-sentence conclusion.

turns.assistant_message:
Robustness and resilience are two crucial aspects of machine learning systems that determine their ability to perform reliably under varying conditions. Robustness refers to the system's capability to maintain accurate predictions or outputs despite encountering outliers, noise, or anomalies in the input data. In contrast, resilience pertains to a system's capacity to recover quickly from errors or failures and continue functioning effectively.

One stress-test example is subjecting the machine learning model to adversarial examples, which are carefully crafted inputs designed specifically to deceive or corrupt the system. By exposing the model to these challenging scenarios, practitioners can assess its robustness against intentional attacks or unintended perturbations
